# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration cand_0001 (parent: seed baseline, val=0.200; passing=25,37; failing=8,11,12,17,19,22,23,40).
This is the only iteration in the run, so I favored BREADTH: ship every fix that is REAL+SAFE+VERIFIED in one candidate.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | DOB blocker (agent asks user for a dob / transfers because dob "not provided") | 40, 23, (8 latent) | Agent treats dob as user-supplied; it is on file. Also wrong arg-key `date_of_birth`. | KNOWLEDGE + BEHAVIORAL | in-body backfill + key normalization + docstring |
| 2 | Bad write args on book_reservation | 23 | passenger `date_of_birth` key + invented payment `{type,id}` instead of `{payment_id}`. | KNOWLEDGE (schema) | in-body key normalization + docstring worked examples |
| 3 | Baggage total/nonfree semantics | 12 | Confuses total vs nonfree vs free-allowance; wrong nonfree → DB mismatch. | KNOWLEDGE | in-body recompute of nonfree from policy table |
| 4 | Premature transfer | 40, 11, 23 | Transfers for solvable situations (missing dob on file / unknown res id / routine change). | BEHAVIORAL | additive NARROWING docstring (never loosens) |
| 5 | Narrated-without-action / confirm-then-STOP | 17, 19, 22 | User turn carries ###STOP###/###TRANSFER### → sim ends before any write call. No tool ever runs. | ORCHESTRATION (out of tool scope) | SKIPPED — un-fixable from the tool surface |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1,2,4 | code + doc | book_reservation.py | Normalizes dob-key spellings→`dob`; backfills missing dob from account-holder profile / saved_passengers (internal env_get_user_details, not a model call); normalizes payment `id`→`payment_id` and drops `type`; raises actionable error if dob truly absent (tells agent to READ it, not ask/guess). Generalizes to any book with wrong dob key or omitted account-holder dob or invented payment shape. | YES — 25 passes correct keys; verified byte-identical pass-through and profile NOT fetched. |
| 1,4 | code + doc | update_reservation_passengers.py | For name changes, backfills each missing dob from the current reservation (exact-name → positional slot → first-name → last-name), so a name change never needs a user-typed dob and never justifies a transfer. | YES — no passing task calls this tool. |
| 3 | code + doc | update_reservation_baggages.py | Recomputes nonfree = max(0, total − free_allowance) from membership×cabin×pax using the policy table; clamps nonfree ≤ total; falls back to passed value on any error. | YES — no passing task calls this tool. |
| 4 | doc only (additive) | transfer_to_human_agents.py | Adds an explicit "Do NOT transfer" list (missing dob on file / unknown res id / routine tool-supported change) WITHOUT removing or loosening either original transfer condition. | YES — narrows only; original OR-conditions intact. |

Deliberately NOT touched: update_reservation_flights.py (task 37 passes via it — any change risks its arg-filling/tool-selection → unbounded regression).

## Verify-the-fix (ran each tool body with stubbed env_* on the EXACT trace args)
- book_reservation / task 23: input passenger `{...,"date_of_birth":"1990-06-15"}`, payment `{"type":"certificate","id":"certificate_3765853","amount":200}` → tool sends `dob:"1990-06-15"` and `{"payment_id":"certificate_3765853","amount":200}`. FIRES ✓
- book_reservation / task 25 (PASSING): correct `dob` + two `payment_id` methods → sent byte-identical; env_get_user_details NOT called. NO-OP ✓
- book_reservation / missing account-holder dob → backfilled from profile dob. FIRES ✓
- update_reservation_passengers / task 40: `[{Anya Garcia,dob},{Mei Garcia (no dob)}]` vs existing `[Anya Garcia,Mei Lee]` → Mei Garcia gets Mei Lee's dob 1989-12-13 via POSITIONAL match (NOT last-name Garcia→Anya). FIRES ✓
- update_reservation_baggages / task 12: gold/economy/1pax total=3 → nonfree 3→0; regular/economy/2pax total=5 → nonfree 0→3. FIRES ✓; fetch-error → falls back to passed value. SAFE ✓
- All 4 files: exactly one top-level function, `ast.parse` clean.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees / parallel features used: none — serial; the task is 4 small tool files with a single scratch verify harness (removed before snapshot).
- Prior iterations I read from ./prior_iterations/ + ./RUNMAP.md: NONE exist (RUNMAP/LEDGER/prior_iterations/rejected.jsonl all empty — this is the first candidate).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The DOB-backfill pattern (read on file via internal env_ call, never ask the user) — root cause of the largest failing cluster.
- book_reservation payment/dob key normalization and the "call in the SAME turn as yes" instruction.
- transfer_to_human_agents docstring is NARROWED only; never loosen its two original transfer conditions.
- Do NOT modify update_reservation_flights (protects task 37).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Tasks 17, 19, 22 (narrated-without-action / confirm-then-STOP): the user's terminating turn carries ###STOP###/###TRANSFER###, ending the sim before the agent gets another turn to emit a write call. No tool body ever executes, so the tool surface cannot fix them. Would need an orchestration/prompt change outside this run's edit surface.
- A composite `update_reservation` tool: rejected — it would change tool SELECTION on passing task 37 (unbounded regression risk) for no verified gain.
